question: What happens when the yogin remains without thought and without clearly seen difference?
premises: He abandons the state of clearly seen difference.
As long as he remains thus, the previously described levels respond.
inference: Remaining thought-free and beyond clearly seen difference brings the previously described levels into presence.
plain_english: Thinking of nothing and having abandoned the state of clearly seen difference, as long as he remains so, the previously described levels come forward.
